title: Ms. Jackson backwards guitar
hook: Ms. Jackson is built on Strawberry Letter 23.
voiceover: Ms. Jackson is built on Strawberry Letter 23. 1977, the Brothers Johnson, produced by Quincy Jones, cut Strawberry Letter 23 for A&M. It's a Shuggie Otis song from 1971, but the Johnsons made it a hit, and the guitar figure near the end is the famous part. In 2000 Earthtone 3, that's Andre 3000, Big Boi and David Sheats, took that guitar and turned it around under Ms. Jackson. Not the loop you'd expect. It's reversed, played backwards, so the guitar seems to breathe in instead of out. That's why the record feels like an apology. Stankonia, LaFace, and it went number 1 in early 2001. Save this, then go hear the guitar the right way round.
caption: Ms. Jackson (OutKast, Stankonia, LaFace, 2000, produced by Earthtone III) is the guitar from Strawberry Letter 23 by the Brothers Johnson (A&M, 1977, produced by Quincy Jones), a Shuggie Otis song from 1971, played backwards. The reversal is why it sounds like an apology. Went number 1 in February 2001. Which Southern flip should I break down next? 🍑
